propositions: The macOS pytest job (macos-latest, py3.13) runs for 18.6m with 15.4m spent on coverage collection via --cov flags, while ubuntu cells enforce the identical coverage floor and consume the coverage report.

Removing --cov and --cov-report flags from macOS matrix cells preserves test selection (7856 tests unchanged) and removes duplicate coverage work, since ubuntu cells already gate the coverage floor identically.
The macOS runner concurrency bottleneck (peak 4 concurrent, causing 6.7-8.4m queue delays) makes macOS job duration doubly valuable as both critical path and scarce resource holder.

GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch resolves reusable workflows from the default branch, not the patchset, so pre-merge Verified votes cannot measure workflow file changes; post-merge observation is required.

Coverage flags must be selected per-matrix OS as '!startsWith(matrix.os, "macos") && "--cov=rebar --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered" || ""' to avoid silent fallthrough where the empty string is treated as falsy.
